coordinateSystem.basis: 640-frame COLMAP reconstruction. Models 3/4/5 merged using overlapping camera poses. Relative route is measured from video; 7m floor separation, 1.6m camera height and world anchoring at 220s (u=20,v=-42) are explicit assumptions authorized by user.

sharedCore.ownership: VideoFloorOne builds both escalators, their well lining/guards and first-floor ceiling opening. VideoFloorTwo excludes this opening from floor slab, mezzanine and fixtures.
sharedCore.inclineBasis: Least-squares SfM175..199: y=0.60871121*v+19.83550597. Relative slope from recovered trajectory; floor7m metric scaling inferred. End landings remain inside original shared opening.
sharedCore.physicalWalkSurface: Continuous slope collider over visible stepped tread, <=45deg, linked to both landing floors; no invisible teleport and no filled 2F opening.
sharedCore.topPortal: u5.2,v-19.0 facing descent toward -v. Low-ceiling retail zone, not open high hall.
